findings.description: The function uses string concatenation to build a SQL query, which allows an attacker to perform SQL injection attacks by manipulating the 'username' parameter.
The function uses string concatenation to build a SQL query, which makes it vulnerable to SQL injection attacks. An attacker could manipulate the 'username' input to execute arbitrary SQL commands.

reasons: The candidate code correctly implements a parameterized query using the '?' placeholder, which effectively prevents SQL injection.
Both security findings regarding string concatenation were resolved by the refactoring.
The implementation is clean, readable, and passes all provided test cases, including an explicit SQL injection attempt test.
